read_this_first: No pass line: the distance to Ziva is reported, not judged (ADR-17).

ziva_full_face is the reference (the lab's real setup). ziva_lips_only is a sensitivity experiment we made by switching 42 objects off; its boundary conditions are not ours and it is still falling at frame 14.
Ziva's runs were played by our script from the lab's motion file, not by a researcher in the lab's interface.

physics = before the landmark layer (rest shape + gravity settle + what the jaw drags along); final = the same frame's physics + the same frame's landmark layer. Neither is compared with the target pose.
Every 'last pose' number names its frame: 36 (the motion has just stopped) or 46 (held 10 frames more).
Each side is in its own world geometry; the physical scales are not aligned (docs/11 D18), so a difference is a difference, not yet an explanation.

not_matched.note: inferred, not checked on the machine: 100 Maya units are 1 m in Ziva's solver. A third length scale, neither 0.962 mm per scene unit nor our k (docs/11 D18)

not_matched.ziva: gravityY ['-9.8'] in the solver's own units
not_matched.note: how Ziva's value becomes a displacement in the world was not measured

differences_between_the_setups.ziva_lips_only: the neighbouring tissues are switched off and do not move
